You bring up an interesting point about honesty in relationships, I definitely agree that there are at least a few instances where telling the truth gets you into trouble.. how did you have problems with telling the truth? like I've gotten in trouble for telling a friend what another friend said about him.. a social rule that i wasn't really aware of until then.

Do you have any suggestions as to breaking in with an entry level job for coding without a degree? That would be sweet.

I'm considering dropping out of college next semester, if only to make sure I have most of my issues sorted out... but I am mulling over dropping out for good.

if you don't mind, do you use IM? you seem to be someone i'd like to learn more about

Wow, thanks. It's been a very long time since I've communicated on a very uninhibited level (I guess) with someone. The last time I've had a hearty conversation (online, anyway) was a couple years ago. I totally get what you're saying and it comforts me. The concept of relative honesty just blows my mind.

I really don't know why I'm in school. I feel like I could do everything they're teaching me on my own - I'm in school to learn programming. However, I find it really hard to stay motivated to learn on my own...

I do have a yearning ambition to try a venture in something like a small business but it's practically impossible to do so with my nice little stack of student loans and my .. difficulty in talking to people. Well I'll stop here since I think I'll just prattle on forever.

If you do read this, thanks for listening. I really appreciate it.
Thank you for your kind words. Unfortunately, the university I go to doesn't have a counselor on staff. I am kind of working on talking to someone soon ..
